conditional_decoder_comparison.profile: C4, one logical host CPU, identical retained requests and teacher histories to the BF16 KV control
conditional_decoder_comparison.top20_overlap: 19 at coordinate offset 9, 20 at the other nine selected rows
conditional_decoder_comparison.closure: Deliberate controller stop after all four completed responses; receipt success=false and controlled EOF/termination remain retained. Job zero, drains EOF, closed handles, all 76 inputs released.
conditional_decoder_comparison.limits: Candidate top-20 tails are censored and not renormalized; full-vocabulary CPU rows do not supply full-vocabulary candidate error. Each candidate window starts with full-prefix prefill while CPU carries a continuous teacher cache. Actual normalized tensors/full multimodal prompt IDs are uncaptured. Q8 changes rotations and attention arithmetic, not only scalar storage rounding. No C6 token diagnostic or whole-model equivalence follows.

supplemental_attention_operator.closure: Exit 0, Job zero, drains EOF, closed handles; 83 original inputs plus one copied executable released.
supplemental_attention_operator.limits: Stock random quantized operands, interleaved heads and packed initialized sequence strides. CPU quantizes Q to Q8_0 and accumulates dequantized V in F32; this is implementation agreement, not an unquantized FP32 oracle. No production reservation-gap, exact causal history, trained activations, cache-update or Hadamard-transform validation. The rejected uninitialized-gap fixture was never executed.

c4.bf16_comparison: Three content strings exactly match retained BF16 warmups. Scanned-0 differs only in four boxes by at most one normalized coordinate unit; both source predicates pass. Text, other markup and all usage counts match.

complete_page_gates.scope: Separate cold cohorts, not sustained rates or independent per-page latency samples. Both closed with outer exit 0, both Jobs zero, drains EOF, closed handles and no inner fault; deliberate inner idle-retirement status 3235774465 is retained. Exact idle latency is unmeasured. The failed C4 launch made no POST and remains excluded.

sustained.scope: Includes endpoint CPU image preparation, queueing, inference and final drain; excludes PDF rendering, cold loading, warmup and offline assessment. Repeated four-case synthetic corpus. No incomplete measured request is dropped from the full-cohort denominator.

c4.prior_failure: The earlier parent cohort failed admission; this successful logging-only admission diagnostic neither replaces that failure nor proves its cause. Admission decisions and resource guards were unchanged.

sustained.closure: Each cohort ended with outer exit 0, both Jobs zero, drains EOF, closed handles/descriptors and no inner fault. Inner status 3235774465 is deliberate idle retirement after complete requests, not natural engine exit or OCR failure.
sustained.memory_limits: Nested private-memory peaks overlap and must not be added; they are not VRAM or physical-residency measurements. C6's approximately 371 MiB process-cap margin is one observed peak difference, not a future bound, and supplies no C8 capacity claim.

comparisons.scope: Descriptive full-cohort ratios: one Q8 observation per concurrency, two BF16 C4 observations, one Vulkan reference with a shorter 360-second window. No repeated paired estimate, confidence interval, general accuracy ordering, global ceiling or deployment acceptance.

privacy_and_integrity_scope: Raw requests, responses, logs, runtime binaries and machine-private paths remain private. These SHA256 commitments bind retained local evidence, not independent remote attestation. Null cache counters do not prove zero cache use.
